title: LineEdit: Pressing Enter fails to confirm Japanese IME input
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1] ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx (radeonsi, raven, ACO, DRM 3.61, 6.14.0-37-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 3500U with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx (8 threads) - 12.60 GiB memory ### Issue description # Problem Statement I tried to input a character's name into a LineEdit node using Japanese. However, I couldn't commit the Japanese text even after pressing the Enter key. How can I properly commit Japanese IME input by pressing the Enter key in LineEdit? # Problem Image # Debug logs I used the following script to trace keyboard input in CanvasLayer's script: ```gdscript func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void: if event is InputEventKey: print(event) ``` # Observation - When typing in alphanumeric mode (half-width), InputEventKey is printed to the log as expected. - When typing in Japanese IME mode (full-width), no InputEventKey logs are generated for the keystrokes or the Enter key. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the attached MRP (Minimum Reproducible Project). 2. Enter any Japanese text into the LineEdit node. 3. Observe that the input is not committed when pressing Enter. Note: Although some error logs may appear due to the project being minimized, the issue is consistently reproducible. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25416607/mrp.zip)
